explication: OmniVoice is a multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech system. The principal workflow is: a user submits text, optional reference speech/transcript, or voice attributes through the Python API or CLI; OmniVoice normalizes controls, optionally transcribes reference speech, creates conditioning prompts, and generates audio. The repository also contains separate training and evaluation workflows. The graph reflects documented capabilities and sampled implementations; several internal model calls and unsampled CLI wiring are therefore intentionally omitted.
